english.title: Manufacturer fail to keep / maintain register of information relating to pyrotechnic article (not F1/F2/F3 firework)
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was the manufacturer of pyrotechnic articles other than category F1, F2 or F3 fireworks, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PYROTECHNIC ARTICLES..), and failed to keep a register and promptly make entries in that register of the information required by regulation 21(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015, namely **(..SPECIFY THE NATURE OF NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 21(2), 62(1)(j) and 63(2) of the Pyrotechnic Articles (Safety) Regulations 2015.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a manufacturer

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Where this offence is committed in respect of a pyrotechnic article to which regulation 63(1) applies (i.e. a category F1, F2 or F3 firework), it is summary only - see offence document H12253 (CJS code PA15016)
